policy.defaultReadSurface: Use MCP or an installed app for structured investigation when it is scoped to the intended account and environment.
policy.defaultWriteSurface: Use a reviewed repository command or provider CLI for repeatable writes. Production actions remain subject to their existing authorization contract.
policy.runtimeSurface: Application traffic uses SDKs, HTTP APIs, webhooks, or OTLP. MCP is never an application runtime dependency.
policy.secretHandling: Never print or copy provider secrets into chat, tracked files, command arguments, or diagnostic output.

services.name: Supabase / Postgres
services.purpose: Authentication, PostgreSQL persistence, RLS, and database migrations.
services.runtimeSurface: Supabase SSR/JS clients plus Drizzle over PostgreSQL.

agent.guidance: Use repository database commands and the Supabase CLI for deterministic work. Use only the isolated Preview project in a project-scoped, read-only MCP for investigation.

services.writePolicy: Preview migrations use the guarded repository alias and explicit confirmation. Production data or schema changes require the existing backup, preflight, and owner-authorization procedure.

services.name: LiveKit + voice inference
services.purpose: Realtime interview rooms, explicit agent dispatch, voice workers, and Deepgram/OpenAI/Cartesia/ElevenLabs inference.
services.runtimeSurface: LiveKit server/client SDKs and Python LiveKit Agents; model providers are reached through the reviewed voice runtime configuration.

agent.guidance: Use the LiveKit Docs MCP for current API and deployment knowledge, the lk CLI for project inspection, and guarded repository deploy wrappers for Production workers.

targets.genericPreview: Vercel target preview; LiveKit intentionally disabled

services.writePolicy: Generic Vercel Preview receives no LiveKit credentials. Trusted staging uses the isolated project. Production worker deploys must use the signed repository authorization wrappers and must build from the exact reviewed source snapshot.

services.name: OpenAI
services.purpose: Post-interview feedback evaluation, calibration, and the LiveKit interview dialogue model.
services.runtimeSurface: The OpenAI Node SDK handles feedback; LiveKit inference handles interview dialogue.

agent.guidance: Use repository tests and calibration entrypoints. Use official OpenAI documentation for current API behavior; do not treat an MCP as the runtime or credential path.

services.writePolicy: Normal evaluation writes flow through application workflows. Paid calibration and Production changes retain their separate spend and owner-authorization boundaries.

services.name: Stripe
services.purpose: Checkout, subscriptions, credits, billing portal, refunds, disputes, and webhook convergence.
services.runtimeSurface: Stripe Node SDK and signed webhooks behind billing workflows.

agent.guidance: Use MCP for scoped documentation and read-heavy investigation, the Stripe CLI for local webhook work, and guarded repository commands for catalog or Production mutations.

mcp.name: stripe
mcp.setup: codex mcp add stripe --url https://mcp.stripe.com && codex mcp login stripe

services.writePolicy: MCP and CLI writes require the exact intended test/live account and human confirmation. Live catalog changes use the guarded repository workflow; refunds and billing exceptions remain owner-controlled.

services.name: Inngest
services.purpose: Durable feedback, interview recovery, cleanup, insights, and account-deletion jobs.
services.runtimeSurface: Inngest SDK events and functions served from the Next.js application.

agent.guidance: Use npm run dev:local and the local MCP for development runs. Use the environment-scoped cloud CLI/API only for hosted run investigation.

services.writePolicy: The local MCP may invoke only local functions and events. Cloud inspection requires an environment-scoped API key; Production event sends require explicit operational scope.

services.name: Statsig
services.purpose: Server-owned relaunch access and consent-gated browser evaluation.
services.runtimeSurface: Statsig JS SDK through the same-origin proxy and server resolver.

agent.guidance: Use MCP for read-only gate/config evidence. Provider writes are owner-governed and never implied by technical readiness.

mcp.name: statsig
mcp.setup: codex mcp add statsig --url https://api.statsig.com/v1/mcp && codex mcp login statsig

services.writePolicy: Keep Production/default-on human-owned. Ordinary agents may collect read-only evidence but may not enable the gate, widen targeting, or claim launch GO.

services.name: PostHog
services.purpose: Explicit-consent product analytics and redacted operational evidence.
services.runtimeSurface: PostHog browser and Node SDK adapters behind the analytics-consent contract.

agent.guidance: Use the installed PostHog app for analysis and repository tests for event behavior. Do not bypass the consent and event allowlists.

services.writePolicy: Analytics changes must preserve explicit consent, pseudonymous identities, disabled replay/autocapture, and the closed event allowlist.

services.name: Comet Opik
services.purpose: LLM and voice-agent observability, trace investigation, scoring, prompts, and experiments.
services.runtimeSurface: Sanitized HTTP/OTLP trace export from TypeScript and Python, disabled by default.

agent.guidance: Use the hosted OAuth MCP for trace investigation. Runtime ingestion still uses environment-owned API keys; write, Ollie, and experiment tools remain approval-gated.

mcp.name: opik
mcp.setup: codex mcp add opik --url https://www.comet.com/opik/api/v1/mcp && codex mcp login opik

services.writePolicy: Tracing and content capture remain off by default. MCP write, Ollie, and experiment calls require confirmation; Production enablement requires the existing disclosure, retention, and deploy guardrails.

services.name: Google Sheets question source
services.purpose: Source of curated PM interview questions synchronized into the database.
services.runtimeSurface: Published CSV or authenticated Google Sheets API normalized by the question-sync workflow.

agent.guidance: Use the Google Sheets app for source inspection and the single repository question-sync workflow for dry runs or writes.

services.writePolicy: The sheet is a source; application database writes go only through the authenticated, transactional question-sync workflow. Production sync remains owner-authorized.

services.name: Vercel
services.purpose: Web deployments, environment variables, preview/staging targets, and build preflight.
services.runtimeSurface: Vercel-hosted Next.js deployment and environment configuration.

agent.guidance: Use the repository-pinned Vercel CLI commands. Link the exact meelni team/project before inspecting or changing environments.

services.writePolicy: Use npx vercel@55.0.0 with --scope meelni. The owner-only Production web Shadow canary uses its exact one-use configuration/redeployment action; every other Production promotion or sensitive environment change retains its existing owner authorization and deployment boundary.

services.name: GitHub
services.purpose: Source control, pull requests, checks, Actions, and repository governance.
services.runtimeSurface: Git and GitHub Actions; not an application runtime dependency.

agent.guidance: Use git/gh for branch-aware work and checks, and the GitHub MCP/app for structured PR and issue inspection.

mcp.name: github
mcp.setup: Configure the installed GitHub app/MCP with the repository-scoped operator credential.

services.writePolicy: Confirm branch, diff, remote, and intended repository before writes. Repository settings, protections, secrets, and Actions variables require explicit scope.

services.name: Linear
services.purpose: Meelni workstream planning, issue state, evidence, and handoff.
services.runtimeSurface: Operational planning only; not an application runtime dependency.

agent.guidance: Use the Linear app/MCP and the Meelni Linear skill. Preserve owner-gated parent issues and use PR-sized child issues for repo increments.

mcp.name: linear
mcp.setup: codex mcp add linear --url https://mcp.linear.app/mcp && codex mcp login linear

services.writePolicy: Issue mutations follow the meelni-linear-workstream skill. Do not let a child PR or terminal keyword close an owner-gated parent prematurely.

services.name: GitGuardian
services.purpose: Repository secret scanning through a repository-scoped GitHub App.
services.runtimeSurface: GitHub App checks only; not an application runtime dependency.

agent.guidance: Use gh to verify the GitHub App installation and use PR checks as the end-to-end proof.

services.writePolicy: Keep the GitHub App repository-scoped. Do not expose findings that contain real secrets; rotate any validated credential through its provider.
